international.title: US Senate approves bill to speed up permitting reviews for energy projects and datacenters
international.summary: Bipartisan legislation now goes to the House amid concerns by some Democrats and environmental groups The Senate approved bipartisan legislation on Thursday aimed at speeding up permitting reviews to build power plants, transmission lines and other energy infrastructure as lawmakers seek to increase the nation’s energy supplies to meet surging demand and lower electricity prices. The legislation’s sweeping changes would shorten the timeline to start big energy projects and make sure data centers pay for the energy they use. Anger over datacenters and rising electricity prices helped usher in a wave of Democrats pledging to clamp down on the energy-hungry behemoths. Continue reading...
